_about: The count-triggered template lines behind the no-AI budget draft (src/lib/rules-preprod.js proposeBudget, docs/RULES-BREAKDOWN.md A3). A line is proposed only when the schedule or the breakdown triggers it (needs), with its DAYS taken from the schedule; the rate is never typed here. A line named in `item` must be a preset in rates.chennai.2024.json (presets) so the rate card can show its band; a line with `custom` has no band and its rate stays blank. {count} is the scenes that triggered it (for example 2 scenes), {days} the days (for example 3 days).
midpointLabel: rate card midpoint, an estimate — not a quote

lines.basis: Every shoot day needs a camera; pick the body from the rate card.
A gaffer runs the lights on every shoot day.
{count} at night, over {days}, need extra light.
